gates.note: Mirrors urirun-connector-plesk: apply is refused unless every gate is set and the caller replays the exact hash of a plan this process issued.

multidomain.note: One Plesk account (API/SSH) owns many subscriptions. This SaaS pattern is one subscription hosting tenant subdomains; other products use other subscriptions under the same account. Limits come from the live subscription, not from a single hardcoded domain.
